ios-archive.description: Archive committed HEAD locally with production configuration and matching dSYMs

ios-export.description: Export a signed IPA locally; RELEASE_DIR is the archive's release directory
steps: PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$PATH" asc xcode export --archive-path "${RELEASE_DIR:?Set RELEASE_DIR}/Palace.xcarchive" --export-options scripts/ios-export-options.plist --ipa-path "$RELEASE_DIR/Palace.ipa" --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates --output json > "$RELEASE_DIR/export.json"

ios-upload.description: Upload the exported IPA and wait for Apple processing; does not distribute

ios-distribute.description: Assign an exact processed build to an explicitly selected TestFlight group
steps: asc publish testflight --app "$APP_ID" --build-id "${BUILD_ID:?Set BUILD_ID from the uploaded build}" --group "${GROUP_ID:?Set GROUP_ID from testflight groups list}" --wait --timeout 30m --output json
